en: Colorized panoramic view over a small industrial town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground shows steep, slate-roofed houses, chimneys, and factory smokestacks among trees. A long straight street lined with houses leads towards the center of the town. The scene has a vintage, early-20th-century printed-postcard style. In the sky area at the top left, red text reads "Olbernhau i. Erzgeb."
